"""Read-only audit of exact argument paths beneath this optimization run."""
import json,os,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).absolute().parent
owned=[]
for entry in Path('/proc').iterdir():
    if not entry.name.isdigit() or int(entry.name)==os.getpid():continue
    try:args=(entry/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
    except (FileNotFoundError,PermissionError,ProcessLookupError):continue
    matched=False
    decoded=[arg.decode(errors='replace') for arg in args if arg]
    for arg in decoded[1:]:
        if arg.startswith('-') or '\n' in arg:continue
        try:path=Path(arg).absolute()
        except (OSError,ValueError):continue
        if path==root or root in path.parents:matched=True
    if matched:owned.append(dict(pid=int(entry.name),arguments=decoded))
# Also verify captured descendants whose generic spawn/resource-tracker argv
# does not contain a script path. Observe only the same PID/start-time identity.
tracked=[]
history=root/'owned-process-tree.json'
if history.exists():
 for item in json.loads(history.read_text())['processes']:
  pid=item['pid']
  if pid==os.getpid():continue
  try:fields=(Path('/proc')/str(pid)/'stat').read_text().rsplit(') ',1)[1].split()
  except (FileNotFoundError,PermissionError,ProcessLookupError):continue
  if int(fields[19])!=item['start_time_ticks']:continue
  state=fields[0];tracked.append(dict(pid=pid,state=state,start_time_ticks=item['start_time_ticks']))
  if state!='Z' and pid not in {x['pid'] for x in owned}:owned.append(dict(pid=pid,arguments=item['arguments'],ownership='Captured descendant with unchanged start ticks'))
report=dict(status='passed' if not owned else 'running',observed_epoch=time.time(),owned_processes=owned,captured_processes_still_present=tracked,scope='Read-only /proc audit of argument paths below this exact optimization directory. name='final-process-audit.json' if not owned else 'process-audit-progress.json'
